trigger: Units in a RECEIVING (or UNASSIGNED after go-live) bin longer than WH_RECEIVING_MAX_HOURS
auto_close: RECEIVING qty of the SKU = 0

trigger: Order line could not be fully reserved at intake (available < needed) or its reservation expired
owner_rule: STOCK fewest open → shop VA copied
auto_close: line fully reserved or cancelled / marked out of stock

trigger: Picker reported fewer units in a bin than the system (short pick)
auto_close: triggered count of the bin posted

trigger: Pick list idle longer than WH_PICK_ABANDON_HOURS – unpicked lines released
owner_rule: pick list assignee's supervisor → STOCK fewest open
auto_close: pick task closed or reassigned and finished

trigger: Order line not Ready and dispatch-by within the carrier cut-off of today (or passed)
auto_close: all lines of shop × date Ready or handed over

trigger: Parcel Ready (or labelled) and not handed over after its carrier's collection / cut-off time
auto_close: all parcels of carrier × site × date handed over or voided

trigger: Handover session closed with WRONG CARRIER / NOT READY / UNKNOWN scans not resolved
auto_close: every exception marked resolved with a note

trigger: Handed-over parcel with no delivery after carrier profile claim_days or buyer not-received case
auto_close: case closed (delivered / claim paid / claim rejected with note)

trigger: Return intake saved without a matching order
auto_close: intake matched or booked as found stock / disposed

trigger: Return booked and the order line has no refund or refund proposal
auto_close: refund saved or proposal accepted / rejected with reason

trigger: Count session created by schedule (ABC) or trigger (short pick / zero / negative attempt / no room) not finished in 1 day
auto_close: count POSTED or CANCELLED with reason

trigger: Count line variance above recount threshold needs a blind recount by another person
owner_rule: STOCK fewest open (not the first counter)
auto_close: recount entered

trigger: Units in a MISSING bin older than WH_MISSING_WRITE_OFF_DAYS
auto_close: MISSING qty of the SKU = 0 (found or written off)

trigger: PRIMARY home below its min and other bins of the site hold the SKU (REPLEN_MODE ALERT or TASK)
auto_close: home qty ≥ min or no other stock

trigger: Reconciliation: Σ physical ≠ Σ book lots / bin ≠ physical ledger / SHIPPED ≠ shipped-awaiting / DISPATCH ≠ open parcels
auto_close: next reconciliation run equal

trigger: Units still in UNASSIGNED WH_UNASSIGNED_DAYS after go-live or after a found-stock booking
auto_close: UNASSIGNED qty of the SKU = 0

trigger: Storage mode FIXED and an active SKU with physical stock at a site has no PRIMARY home
auto_close: PRIMARY home set or stock 0

trigger: Batch being confirmed (or past month end) has own-stock SELF lines of a managed site with no ship record
auto_close: every such line shipped (or backfilled) or not own-stock

trigger: Shipped units of a shop × month still not confirmed after month end + profile overdue_days
auto_close: month batch confirmed

trigger: Units in RETURNS / QUARANTINE / DAMAGED older than WH_HOLD_AGED_DAYS without a decision
auto_close: units moved / written off / claimed

trigger: Print job FAILED (printer offline / PDF maker missing)
auto_close: a later job on that printer PRINTED

trigger: More than WH_ADJUST_ALERT_PER_WEEK adjustments by one user or on one SKU in 7 days
auto_close: reviewed with note

trigger: Slotting suggestions waiting for approval (weekly)
auto_close: no open suggestion
